title: Do We Really Need an LLM for Weight-Space Programming? A Deterministic Forward-Only Paradigm and Its Capability Boundaries
abstract: arXiv:2611.34612v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work on Weight-Space Programming uses LLMs to edit neural weights with forward passes only, conflating LLM scripting with the underlying algebra of forward-only editing. We show that for core structured editing regimes, an LLM optimizer is unnecessary, and introduce Forward Weight-Space Programming (FWSP): a deterministic pipeline combining probing, localization, stratified operators (O1-O4), automatic blind routing (83.3% vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM with the same tool library), and paired verification with zero additional per-token computation. For reasoning LLMs, we propose Protected FisherGate, a closed-form covariance-whitened readout edit orthogonal to normal-reasoning states: on DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B, a single frozen math-calibrated patch achieves 84.2% HumanEval pass@1 (1K budget; 75.4 +/- 9.4% across 3/5 Stage-4-passing subsets), beating 512-token-reserved budget forcing by +14.6 pp (-23.4% tokens) while transferring across HF-t

translated_title: 我们真的需要大语言模型来做权重空间编程吗？一种确定性的仅前向传播范式及其能力边界
translated_abstract: 近期关于权重空间编程的工作使用大语言模型在仅前向传播的条件下编辑神经网络权重，将LLM脚本编写与仅前向编辑背后的代数机制混为一谈。我们证明，对于核心的结构化编辑任务，LLM优化器是不必要的，并提出前向权重空间编程（FWSP）：一个确定性流水线，结合了探测、定位、分层算子（O1-O4）、自动盲路由（成功率83.3%，而使用相同工具库的27B LLM仅为33.3%）以及成对验证，且无需任何额外的逐token计算。针对推理型LLM，我们提出Protected FisherGate，一种与正常推理状态正交的闭式协方差白化读出层编辑方法：在DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B上，单个冻结的数学校准补丁实现了84.2%的HumanEval pass@1（1K预算；在3/5个通过Stage-4的子集上为75.4 ± 9.4%），比预留512 token的预算强制方法高出+14.6个百分点（节省23.4%的token），并可跨HF-t（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 论文证明权重空间编程并不需要LLM优化器，提出的确定性仅前向FWSP流水线实现83.3%的盲路由成功率（远超27B LLM的33.3%），配合Protected FisherGate补丁将DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B的HumanEval pass@1提升至84.2%且节省23.4%的token。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that LLM optimizers are unnecessary for weight-space programming: the deterministic forward-only FWSP pipeline achieves 83.3% blind routing accuracy (vs. 33.3% for a 27B LLM), and the Protected FisherGate patch lifts DeepSeek-R1-0528-8B's HumanEval pass@1 to 84.2% while saving 23.4% of tokens.
